title: Add a task-summary assistant
body:
Developers want a short summary of open work without reading every task.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `POST /tasks/summary` returns `headline`, `total_open` and `top_tasks` for open tasks.
2. Claude gets exactly one tool, `list_tasks`, from `docs/summary/tool-schema.json`. The app validates the arguments and runs the tool through `TaskService`. Only `status: open` and a limit from 1 to 100 are allowed. Anything else returns an error tool result and runs nothing.
3. The final answer uses the structured output in `docs/summary/output-schema.json`.
4. Before returning, the app checks `total_open`, and the id and title of every top task, against the tool result. A mismatch, or an answer without a tool call, returns 502 `summary_rejected`.
5. A Claude API failure returns 503 `claude_unavailable`. One summary makes at most 4 Claude requests.
6. Tests use a fake client and no network. Existing endpoints do not change.
